questions.prompt: Which of the following are mentioned in 'Belonging Matters'? Select all that apply.
options: You know people in your group
You have staff you can approach
questions.explanation: All of these are mentioned in the section on Belonging Matters.

questions.prompt: According to the deck, belonging is…
options: A bonus, but not really essential
The single biggest factor in whether students stay, attend and succeed
Only a concern for new students
Something the college expects students to sort out for themselves
questions.explanation: Belonging is the single biggest factor in whether students stay, attend and succeed.

questions.prompt: Fill in the blank: for T-Level students, work-related learning is ____.
questions.template: For T-Level students, work-related learning is ____.
questions.explanation: For T-Level students, work-related learning is mandatory.

questions.prompt: Your study programme is more than just lessons. Which of these are part of it? Select all that apply.
options: English & maths (if you haven't yet achieved them)
questions.explanation: All four are part of your study programme.

questions.prompt: What does the deck say Pro Portal is used for?
options: Your timetable, messages from teachers, attendance and progress
questions.explanation: Pro Portal is your digital home: timetable, messages from teachers, attendance, progress and links to learning and services.

questions.prompt: Which kind of college support covers someone to talk to if you're struggling, stressed or low?
questions.explanation: Wellbeing & mental health is someone to talk to if you're struggling, stressed or low.

questions.prompt: Fill in the blank: in the next couple of ____ your campus runs a Freshers Fair.
questions.template: In the next couple of ____ your campus runs a Freshers Fair.
questions.explanation: In the next couple of weeks your campus runs a Freshers Fair.

questions.prompt: What does the deck say you can do if something isn't working at college?
options: Keep it to yourself and try to cope
Tell your teacher early so we can sort it
questions.explanation: If something isn't working, the worst thing you can do is stay quiet. Tell us early and we can sort it.
